text: Reproduced the published failure: landmark correlation was 0.01632944 because independent random voxel effects were interpolated and an AR+SRHT landmark fit was compared to exact iid OLS. Reworked the vignette to use smooth spatial task fields and a like-for-like full-voxel SRHT/global-AR reference. Current deterministic output: correlation 0.8729467, RMSE 0.2372427, NRMSE 0.4922901, guarded by correlation > 0.85 and NRMSE < 0.60. Replaced >0.01 regression test with both metrics, public noise_spec pooling, and removed unsupported runtime, parcel-boundary, and universal-fidelity claims. Focused landmark/Nyström tests all pass; two fresh renders are byte-identical (SHA-256 a94f2232f95c24cdadbaecf219ae7aa39a1ac5ca560ddf9ac907295e898017cc).
